title: Video Reference
description: Per-widget reference course for the Video widget. Covers YouTube embeds, MP4 (HTML5 <video>), clickable transcripts with click-to-seek, autoplay/startAt edges, and a realistic didactic example using a 3Blue1Brown video.

modules.summary: Four lessons exercising the Video widget across YouTube and MP4 sources, transcript click-to-seek, and a real didactic embedding.
